answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 directly supports pipeline quality and stronger enterprise conversion, though it omits closed-won revenue and retention. Memories 31 and 86 show durable activation/onboarding improvements but do not establish downstream qualified revenue, monetization, or retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits durability, discount economics, customer quality, and retention. Memory 91 only establishes improved early engagement and first meaningful action, with no revenue, qualification, or retention evidence.
